_doc: NONASK-1103 S7: lexicon/pattern detector for current-state questions. Deterministic; a model fallback is not implemented (S7b, flag off).
_r2_note: RELEVANCE-R1R4-1106 R2: "status quo" stays a time cue (political questions), but the framing idioms "de facto status quo", and "status quo bias" are masked by negations; a bare "status quo best practice(s)" stays a currency cue (test_subquery_1103).
_calibration_note: Curated lists, not tuned numbers (2026-11-03). Targets recall>=0.9 and false-trigger<=0.05 are PRIORS, not measured. named_recent_events is empty until the owner curates it (no invented events). 'state of the art' triggers by design: it asks for the present frontier. Physics/legal senses are handled by the negations list; extend from the S0 confusion matrix, not by ear.
